svg.title: Exact questions with persistent Agency ACP and PLANNED Azure
svg.desc: Direct multi-click rows or the manual chooser create a local draft. Only manual configured Ask sends ExactText. SourceRefs stay local; SnapshotOnly sends nothing, and Azure remains planned.
